architecture.convolution_block: Two padded 3x3 Conv/GroupNorm/SiLU layers per block
architecture.attention_gates: Additive 1x1 skip/decoder projections; SiLU, 1x1 score convolution, sigmoid; multiply skip by coefficient. Gates `att3(third,up3)`, `att2(second,up2)`, `att1(first,up1)` before decoder concatenation.
architecture.upsampling: Bilinear interpolation to matching skip size; align_corners=false
